files.title: The estimate
files.what: Every piece of work with its quantity, the client's rate and your labour and material cost.
files.goes: BOQ and budget: Import from Excel
files.catch: Three lines have no cost yet, one is priced below what it costs, and the site's plastering could be any of three lines: Mesiri shows all three, and asks you which plastering.

files.title: Materials and suppliers
files.what: New items, the shops you buy from, what you owe one of them, opening stock and minimums.
files.goes: Bring your data: Materials, vendors and opening stock
files.catch: Cement, Malabar and Joy Tiling are already in Mesiri: the preview says so and leaves them as they are.

files.title: Contract summary
files.what: The client, the dates, the advance, retention and the defects period.
files.catch: The handover date you type sets the schedule's finish.

files.file: Green Villa - ground floor plan A-101.pdf
files.title: Ground floor plan (A-101)
files.what: The architect's plan: every room with its size and the area printed on it.
files.catch: One bedroom is labelled bigger than it is drawn: Mesiri works out the real area and says the label was copied.

files.title: Three quotations: cement and steel
files.what: Malabar, Kerala Steels and Sri Hardwares quote for 300 bags of cement and 2,000 kg of steel.
files.goes: Quotations: a request to the three, then their rates
files.catch: The cheapest for cement is not the cheapest in total, and splitting the order beats both. The compare shows each.

files.title: Delivery challan
files.what: What came on Malabar's lorry for your cement order.
files.catch: The lorry brought 190 bags against an order for 200: the order keeps 10 still to come.

files.title: Malabar's bill
files.what: The supplier's bill for the cement that came.
files.goes: Suppliers: Malabar, match the bill to the delivery
files.catch: The bill's rate is Rs 10 a bag more than the order: Mesiri shows the difference before you pay.

files.title: Joy Tiling: measurement and bill
files.what: The flooring measured room by room, and the subcontractor's bill for it.
files.catch: The bill asks for more square metres than were measured: Mesiri says how many more.

files.file: Green Villa - drawing set rev A.pdf
files.title: The drawing set (8 sheets)
files.what: The architect's and consultants' set: both floor plans, the elevation, a section, the footings, the columns, electrical and plumbing.
files.goes: Drawing check, then Documents (each sheet kept, its rooms and footings tracked as places)
files.catch: The first-floor toilet is drawn smaller than the one below it, and the roof is +660 on the elevation but +655 on the section: Mesiri asks which is right before the slab is cast.

files.title: Building permit
files.what: The municipality's permit: the plot, the built-up area, the floors allowed.
files.catch: None: it is kept where everyone on the project can find the latest one.

files.title: Periyar's rate card
files.what: The rates agreed with the sand and aggregate supplier for the year.
files.goes: Rates (and the rate on each order)
files.catch: M sand is agreed at Rs 1,650 a cum, but the later loads come at Rs 1,750: Rates shows the rise.

files.title: Return note
files.what: Six torn bags from Malabar's load sent back.
files.catch: The debit note takes Rs 2,400 off what you owe Malabar at once, before their next bill.

files.title: A hire bill
files.what: The concrete mixer hired for the Annex, billed by the hour.
files.catch: 42 hours billed, 36 logged on site: Mesiri shows the 6 hours (Rs 2,700) to question.

files.title: Handover certificate
files.what: Green Villa handed over to Dr. Anand Krishnan, the defects period starting.
files.catch: None: it starts the 12-month defects period, after which the retention is released.
